items.author: rivikah.bsky.social
items.context: Over Christmas, I plan to play a videogame. What should it be? I am bad at videogames. I like games to have a story, not too much grinding, and interesting mechanics. 3D first person view sometimes makes me sick. I recently enjoyed Disco Elysium, Inmost, and Portal (despite 🤢). Suggestions?
items.text: Papers, Please might fit: 2D, story-driven, a clever core mechanic and no grinding. Unpacking is another gentle one, told through objects and with no first person view.

items.author: paperklay.bsky.social
items.context: If I wanna play handheld, would you suggest Steam Deck or Switch 2?
items.text: It depends on the library. Steam Deck if you want PC games you may already own on Steam, Switch 2 if you mostly want Nintendo games.
